description: This file contains setup and fixture installation functions for ERPNext, including data initialization for domains, item groups, salary components, leave types, designations, territories, customer and supplier groups, sales stages, email templates, and default settings for a new company setup.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Main function to initialize setup fixtures, default data, and configurations for a specified country.

methods.name: install_company
methods.description: Sets up fiscal year and company records based on provided arguments.

methods.name: install_post_company_fixtures
methods.description: Creates default organizational departments and rebuilds the department tree.

methods.name: set_more_defaults
methods.description: Performs additional default setup such as sales, buying, HR settings, UOMs, and item variants.

methods.name: add_uom_data
methods.description: Loads and inserts UOMs and conversion factors from JSON data files.

methods.name: install_defaults
methods.description: Sets up default price lists, enables default currency, and configures stock and shopping cart settings.

methods.name: create_bank_account
methods.description: Creates a bank account record if specified, and sets it as default for the company.

methods.name: get_fy_details
methods.description: Returns fiscal year string based on start and end dates.
